channel.title: Raspberry PI | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: How to set up a full web server on a Raspberry PI
item.description: In this post I am going to show you how to set up a fully operative web server on Raspberry PI. More specifically, this a LAMP server, which means Linux+Apache+MySQL+PHP, which the most common combination you find in most of the servers worldwide.

item.title: I got a Rasperry PI!
item.description: Yes, I’ve got it! After more or less 3 weeks of waiting, I can finally put my hands on my new, shiny Raspberry PI! And I have to say I had lose any hope to get it before 2013, but, unexpectedly, it got to my house just a few hours before 2012 came to the end.
